narration_text: AI Mode conversation: krishnadevarayakrishnadevarayaKrishnadevaraya was the most illustrious emperor of the Vijayanagara Empire, ruling South India from 1509 to 1529 as the third monarch of the Tuluva dynasty. Widely regarded as one of the greatest rulers in Indian history, his reign marked a golden age of political power, cultural brilliance, and economic prosperity. At its peak, his empire stretched across the peninsula, covering modern-day Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, and parts of Odisha. Even the contemporary Mughal founder Babur acknowledged Krishnadevaraya as the most powerful monarch in India
